resources.string: ✖ No notification access — without it the app cannot catch calls
Find TaxNest Caller ID in the list and switch it on
Allow notification access first — tap the button below

This app reads the notifications of calls that reach the shop\'s phone (normal calls and WhatsApp calls) and sends the number to your POS — a popup appears on the sale screen right away showing which customer is calling and what they bought before. You do not have to keep the app open, the phone just has to be on.
Please read this before you allow it. TaxNest Caller ID uses your phone\'s notifications like this:

1) The app reads incoming-call notifications only, and only from two places: your phone\'s own calling app (dialer), and WhatsApp / WhatsApp Business. From those, only the caller\'s number and name are taken.

2) Every other notification is ignored — messages, chats, email, and calls from other apps as well (Messenger, Telegram, Viber, Skype and so on) — none of it is read, none of it is stored, and none of it is sent anywhere.

3) Only four things are sent to your own TaxNest shop account (at taxnest.com.pk, over a secure HTTPS connection): the number, the name, the time, and whether the call was a SIM call or a WhatsApp call. Nothing is given to any third party.
4) There is only one purpose: a popup appears on your POS sale screen right away showing which customer is calling and what they bought before.

5) This call record deletes itself after about 48 hours. You can withdraw the permission whenever you like from your phone\'s settings, or switch the feature off / revoke the phone from POS → Customize — the app keeps working either way.
